sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat(
'SELECT ',
'w.lastmodifeddate AS LastDate, ',
'w.lastid AS LastID, ',
if(
    equals(item().WatermarkColumn,''),
    concat(
        'CAST(''1900-01-01'' AS date) AS LatestDate, ',
        'COALESCE((SELECT MAX(',item().KeyColumn,
        ') FROM water.',item().StageTable,
        '),0) AS LatestID '
    ),
    concat(
        'COALESCE(x.LatestDate,CAST(''1900-01-01'' AS date)) AS LatestDate, ',
        'COALESCE(x.LatestID,0) AS LatestID '
    )
),
'FROM water.lastmodifiles w ',
if(
    equals(item().WatermarkColumn,''),
    '',
    concat(
        'OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ',
        'CAST(',item().WatermarkColumn,' AS date) AS LatestDate, ',
        'CAST(',item().KeyColumn,' AS bigint) AS LatestID ',
        'FROM water.',item().StageTable,
        ' ORDER BY ',item().WatermarkColumn,' DESC, ',
        item().KeyColumn,' DESC) x '
    )
),
'WHERE w.Tablename = ''',item().TableName,''''
)

@concat(
    'SELECT * FROM water.',
    item().StageTable,
    ' WHERE ',
    if(
        equals(item().WatermarkColumn,''),
        concat(
            item().KeyColumn,
            ' > ',
            string(activity('Lookup1').output.firstRow.LastID)
        ),
        concat(
            '(',
            item().WatermarkColumn,
            ' > ''',
            formatDateTime(
                activity('Lookup1').output.firstRow.LastDate,
                'yyyy-MM-dd'
            ),
            ''' OR (',
            item().WatermarkColumn,
            ' = ''',
            formatDateTime(
                activity('Lookup1').output.firstRow.LastDate,
                'yyyy-MM-dd'
            ),
            ''' AND ',
            item().KeyColumn,
            ' > ',
            string(activity('Lookup1').output.firstRow.LastID),
            '))'
        )
    )
)
